name: marketingskills
description: Provides marketing-related skills and capabilities for AI agents and Claude Code, encompassing CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering techniques to optimize digital marketing efforts.

inputs.name: marketing_content
inputs.description: Text or content related to marketing campaigns to be optimized or generated.

inputs.name: analytics_data
inputs.description: Structured data containing metrics from marketing campaigns for analysis and optimization.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: List of relevant keywords to be targeted for SEO optimization.

inputs.name: growth_objectives
inputs.description: Description of strategic goals for growth engineering and marketing.

outputs.name: optimized_content
outputs.description: Marketing copy or campaign content enhanced for conversions and SEO.

outputs.name: performance_report
outputs.description: Analysis results and insights from marketing analytics data.

outputs.name: growth_strategy
outputs.description: Recommended steps and tactics for growth engineering based on inputs.

steps: Input marketing content, keywords, analytics data, and growth goals
Analyze campaign data for performance and optimization opportunities
Apply SEO techniques to enhance content visibility
Generate or refine marketing copy to improve conversion rates
Develop actionable growth strategies based on data and objectives
Output optimized content, actionable reports, and growth plans
use_cases: Automated generation of SEO-optimized marketing copy for AI agents
Data-driven conversion rate optimization for digital campaigns
Analytical insights production for marketing performance evaluation
Strategic growth engineering assistance for startups and businesses
Supporting AI marketing assistants with specialized domain skills
patterns: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) testing and refinement
SEO keyword integration and content enhancement
Growth hacking and engineering best practices

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Optimize the following marketing content for SEO using these keywords: {seo_keywords}. Content: {marketing_content}

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_optimization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Suggest improvements to increase conversion rates in this campaign content: {marketing_content}. Include CRO best practices.

prompt_templates.name: analytics_reporting_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Analyze this marketing analytics data and generate a performance report: {analytics_data}

prompt_templates.name: growth_strategy_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Develop a growth engineering strategy based on these business objectives: {growth_objectives}
